# New or changed solver statements in the sample decks (generated by make_sample_decks.py; no launch)

Model file: config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml + the matrix overrides. Each deck is compared with the primary baseline deck of the same film (S0-01 / S1-01 / S1-02, itself compared with the V2 final run decks in IMPLEMENTATION.md). Only `+` lines are listed; `UNREVIEWED` = no syntax reference.

## S0-01 (2 nm) -> `sample_decks/S0-01_c10_s0_01_2p0.in`

Smoke 1 / primary shared baseline at 2.0 nm: new DFT laws (fit3 dEc/dEg/dm), quasi-2D NC300, surface tail Nt=Ns/t, constant Nd, shared Qf, mu from the shared law, tmun=0. Checks the new option code path (nc300_override) and that every override reaches the deck.

| new / changed statement | syntax reference |
|---|---|

## S0-02 (2 nm) -> `sample_decks/S0-02_c10_s0_02_2p0.in`

Smoke 2 / gate-leakage code path and first quantitative leakage result: S0-01 + self-consistent direct/FN-regime tunnelling QTNLSC.EL (qtnl.derivs) through Al2O3/HfO2 with the leakage-maximising oxide set, j.tun logged, oxide mesh 0.25 nm. Must show non-zero I_G and KCL pass; compares I_D(off) and I_G with the 2 nm floor (the smallest).

| new / changed statement | syntax reference |
|---|---|
| `material region=3 affinity=1.6 eg300=8.8 me.tunnel=0.3` | MATERIAL insulator affinity/eg300/me.tunnel: audit 7.5 table + 3.3, PDF p.303 (ME.TUNNEL or MC for the oxide mass) |
| `material region=4 affinity=3.2 eg300=5.8 me.tunnel=0.1` | MATERIAL insulator affinity/eg300/me.tunnel: audit 7.5 table + 3.3, PDF p.303 (ME.TUNNEL or MC for the oxide mass) |
| `contact name=gate workfunction=4.7 qtunn.cmass=1` | CONTACT QTUNN.CMASS: audit 7.5 table, PDF p.303 Table 3-132, diode/diodeex12 |
| `contact name=source exclude_near` | CONTACT EXCLUDE_NEAR (logical, default False): PDF p.303 "Contact Specifications" (manual text l.13699-13705: NEARFLG automatic for quantum tunnelling; EXCLUDE_NEAR removes an electrode from the nearest-electrode search) + Table 3-132; CONTACT parameter table PDF p.1152 (l.47953) and description p.1157 (l.48137); 5.28.1.R parser key common/atlas.key CONTACTS block "exclude_near LOG 27 f"; 2004 manual p.3-93. No installed example uses it. Added after run_0066 (pad slices booked to S/D) |
| `contact name=drain exclude_near` | CONTACT EXCLUDE_NEAR (logical, default False): PDF p.303 "Contact Specifications" (manual text l.13699-13705: NEARFLG automatic for quantum tunnelling; EXCLUDE_NEAR removes an electrode from the nearest-electrode search) + Table 3-132; CONTACT parameter table PDF p.1152 (l.47953) and description p.1157 (l.48137); 5.28.1.R parser key common/atlas.key CONTACTS block "exclude_near LOG 27 f"; 2004 manual p.3-93. No installed example uses it. Added after run_0066 (pad slices booked to S/D) |
| `models fermi srh temp=300 print qtnlsc.el qtnl.derivs` | MODELS QTNLSC.EL QTNL.DERIVS: audit 7.5, PDF p.301 Tables 3-128/3-129, diode/diodeex12 |
| `log outf=transfer.log j.tun` | LOG J.TUN: audit 7.5 table, PDF p.289, p.1307 (J.TUN logical), diode/diodeex12 |

Ungated-strip deck (audit 7.11 A) at 13.2 nm with the baseline shared parameters: same film/DOS/Nd/Qf on Al2O3/HfO2 without a gate electrode, V_D stepped 0->0.1->0.7 V. Gives G_strip(t) and I(0.7)/I(0.1). Early run: code check and magnitude; frozen repeats in S6.

## S2-12 (2 nm) -> `extra/S2-12_c10_s2_12_2p0.in`

Defect-assisted gate leakage (Ielmini TAT, ITAT.SC.EL with DOPING TAT.TRAP in HfO2) at 2.0 nm: ASSUMED 1e19 cm-3 traps 1.0 eV below the HfO2 band edge, nominal oxide set, trap charge OUT of Poisson (MODELS ^tat.poisson, PDF p.323): at full occupancy the traps would carry 1.5e13 cm-2, far above the fitted Q_f, and the change in I_D would mix an electrostatic shift with collected leakage (2026-10-10 review fix). Matched gate control: S2-04 (2.0 nm) / S2-06 (13.2 nm). Tests the leakage path Codex could not exclude without I_G (Poole-Frenkel-like magnitudes). Syntax VERIFIED (PDF p.320-327, quantumex20), bilayer use UNVERIFIED. The charged-oxide electrostatics are NOT tested by this run.

| new / changed statement | syntax reference |
|---|---|
| `doping region=4 uniform tat.trap conc=1e+19 acceptor sign=1e-13 sigp=1e-13 e.level=1` | DOPING TAT.TRAP: audit 7.5 table, PDF p.323-327 (Table 3-139 example), quantum/quantumex20 |
| `material region=3 affinity=1.25 eg300=8.8 me.tunnel=0.35` | MATERIAL insulator affinity/eg300/me.tunnel: audit 7.5 table + 3.3, PDF p.303 (ME.TUNNEL or MC for the oxide mass) |
